modelOverview: The CODE 11.59 by Audemars Piguet Selfwinding Chronograph is the flyback-chronograph member of the collection AP launched at SIHH 2019 to sit alongside the Royal Oak. Its 41mm case fuses an octagonal middle case with a round bezel and caseback, hollowed lugs and a double-curved sapphire crystal. It is powered by the in-house self-winding integrated chronograph calibre 4401 with flyback function, small seconds, a date and roughly 70 hours of power reserve.
